data.one_liner: Recurrence rule parsing, calculation, and formatting as defined in the iCalendar RFC.
data.what_it_does: Parses, calculates, and converts recurrence rules (RRULE) defined by the iCalendar RFC. Supports generating concrete date instances from rules, serializing to and from strings and JSON, and converting rules into human-readable text.
use_when: You need to handle calendar events with recurring schedules.
You need to parse or generate iCalendar RFC 5545 RRULE strings.
avoid_when: You need built-in handling for complex local time zones and daylight saving transitions within the recurrence calculation itself.
strengths: Compliant with the iCalendar RFC specification for RRULEs.
Supports serialization to/from strings and jCal JSON.
Provides human-readable text generation for rules in multiple languages.
weaknesses: Does not handle time zones natively; all input DateTimes must be in UTC.
Custom week starts (WKST) are not supported (Monday is hardcoded).
